actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 0 (Roll no. 177).
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 405 - 0 (Roll no. 177).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3644-3645)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 3234.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3582-3584; text: CR H3582)
Mr. Hill (AR) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 314.
Reported (Amended) by the Committee on Financial Services. H. Rept. 119-362.

committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects insured depository institutions, banking regulators, and depositors utilizing reciprocal deposit networks.
dimensions.evidence: The sum of the following amounts of reciprocal deposits of an agent institution shall not be considered to be funds obtained... through a deposit broker

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts deposit limits and institutional eligibility ratings, potentially changing deposit management options for banks.
dimensions.evidence: assigned a CAMELS rating of 1, 2, or 3 under the Uniform Financial Institutions Rating System

dimensions.assessment: Reduces the Federal Reserve's discretionary surplus fund by a specific dollar amount at a future date.
dimensions.evidence: The dollar amount specified under section 7(a)(3)(A) of the Federal Reserve Act is reduced by $28,000,000.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Federal Deposit Insurance Act and the Federal Reserve Act regarding reciprocal deposits and regulatory ratings.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Federal Deposit Insurance Act to modify the amount of reciprocal deposits of an insured depository institution

dimensions.assessment: Enacts permanent statutory modifications to deposit rules alongside a one-time study requirement and a future effective date.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect on September 1, 2036.

missing_information: Total volume of additional reciprocal deposits that institutions will accept under the new tiers.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill modifies reciprocal deposit limits for insured depository institutions based on a tiered liability system, expands eligibility criteria using CAMELS ratings, mandates a joint study, and reduces a Federal Reserve surplus fund.
